title: The Ant and the Carefree Fiddler
summary: The ants labored in the heat of summer to store wheat, while the grasshopper sang on a thistle. When winter froze the meadow, the starving grasshopper learned that those who sing a...
full_text: The ants labored in the heat of summer to store wheat, while the grasshopper sang on a thistle. When winter froze the meadow, the starving grasshopper learned that those who sing away summer must dance through the snow.
moral: Work today that you may eat tomorrow.
